runtime: python3 (>=3.8, stdlib only) — no pip installs, no network

entrypoints.contam: scripts/benchscan.py contam --benchmark B.jsonl --corpus C.jsonl [--n 13] [--cutoff YYYY-MM-DD --results R.jsonl]

exit_codes.4: report verdict COMPROMISED / severity CRITICAL / ledger chain broken

catalogue.discipline: engine asserts every emitted finding.cat exists in the static CATALOGUE; rc2 otherwise (anti-hallucination)

severity_formula: round(100*(0.40*min(1,|infl|/15)+0.35*min(1,|aff|/0.10)+0.25*clamp(ev,0,1))); tiers CRITICAL>=75 HIGH>=50 MEDIUM>=25 else LOW
statistics: paired bootstrap CI (percentile, PRNG seeded by input sha256 — deterministic)

policy.ledger: hash-chained JSONL per target name, O_NOFOLLOW + fchmod 0600 at create, monotonic seq; ${BENCHSCAN_LEDGER:-./.bra_history_<name>.jsonl}; keyless-chain limits documented
policy.determinism: bootstrap and all detectors reproducible from the same input bytes

honest_scope: audit/defense tool for benchmark validity. Cannot certify that a model is uncontaminated (training data is unauditable from outside); quantifies offline-auditable signals and declares the rest out of scope. Verdict is INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE when zero channels ran (no false ROBUST on partial runs). P-3 chi2 suppressed on chi2_small_n, and on near-perfect accuracy with stable answers (>=0.995 acc, <0.05 unstable). T-3 requires binomial p<0.05 AND >=8 echo-asymmetric pairs. G-1 pooled test blocks on mixed choice counts. audit always verifies the chain (--verify accepted for compatibility). Ensemble mapping: display letter L at slot j -> content perms[i][j]; raw_acc is first-run letter accuracy (baseline meaningful only when perms[0] is canonical).
